Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the "find-skills" skill.
- Helps users discover and install agent skills based on their queries.
- Guides users through searching, selecting, and installing skills using the Skills CLI (`npx skills`).
- Provides examples and tips for effective skill search.
- Includes advice on what to do if no relevant skills are found.
